verdict.rationale: The product page states cards are 'smart, flexible' with AI-powered spend management so 'every transaction is controlled, categorized, and automatically compliant,' implying some card-level spend controls, but no evidence details specific category/merchant/amount restriction mechanisms or a point-of-sale auto-lock/decline enforcement flow. Missing for 10: documentation of granular category/merchant/amount rule configuration, evidence of real-time point-of-sale decline/lock behavior, and independent/hands-on confirmation of these controls working as described.
